meta.name: Dead End Job
meta.description: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

videos.title: Convenience Store Rules
videos.overview: In debt and out of options, Byeon Hyeok-jun accepts a suspicious convenience store job paying 50 times minimum wage — and quickly learns why.

videos.title: A Journey with a Pierrot
videos.overview: Scared and confused after his last job, Hyeok-jun is now offered a new opportunity with one bizarre rule: Never lose sight of the clown.

videos.title: Milkman Vlog
videos.overview: Hyeok-jun swears off risky jobs — until a milk delivery gig pays 200 times minimum wage. This time, he's fully prepared for whatever comes his way.

videos.title: Midnight Fantasy Cinema
videos.overview: After learning about Hyeok-jun's new job and the agency, his sister Ji-yoon's curiosity leads her to a night shift where her worst fears come to life.

videos.title: Clinical Trial
videos.overview: Posing as another applicant, Hyeok-jun joins a clinical trial where an unexpected encounter with his friend turns the job into a rescue mission.

videos.title: The Walls Don't Talk
videos.overview: With more questions than answers, Hyeok-jun accepts a night-shift job at a construction site and uncovers the real horror behind the mysterious agency.

videos.title: Neo World After Dark
videos.overview: Warned that this final gig will be unlike any before it, Hyeok-jun joins a fairy-tale parade at a theme park where the answers he seeks await.

videos.title: Last Carnival
videos.overview: A nightmarish carnival brings everyone together as Hyeok-jun faces a life-changing decision. Can he finally quit his dead-end job for good?

meta.slogan: 50x Minimum wage guaranteed, will you accept this sweet gig?
